verdict.rationale: GrowthBook explicitly documents evaluating feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge on Cloudflare Workers to eliminate flicker before HTML ships, and also offers a self-hosted GrowthBook Proxy that caches SDK payloads near the app to reduce latency and provide resilience, directly matching the edge/relay-layer use case. Missing for 10: broader edge platform coverage beyond Cloudflare (e.g., other CDN workers like Fastly/Akamai) and independent/hands-on corroboration of edge latency benefits.
